note: STAGED, NOT APPLIED (lane/watched-stamp, backend-architect, 2026-11-22; AR-6 follow-up, the board's "Away card: server-side watched stamp", the Coordinator's option (a)). THE SERVER'S WATCHED MARK. NEW table hunt_watch (user_id, slot) PK: the numbers at a hero's last viewed ask (mark: session, server clock, Level XP and its Level, the session's coins + cover, store gold and kills, a trained skill) and the mark that closed its last absence (away, back); RLS on, no policy, no client grant. NEW hr_hunt_watch_note(uuid, int) (SECURITY DEFINER, VOLATILE, EXECUTE for hr_engine only, every client role and hr_tick refused by its body): one upsert of the caller's own row from its own server rows, called only by a viewed ask (a term of its read and, when it saves, of its commit after the apply). NEW hr_hunt_watch_view (the `watched` section in hr_state_sections: the mark a return is judged from, else null) and hr_hunt_watch_gap() (1 minute). The detector's engine entry rides 1032-approved-cuts.sql's link 25 (tools/derive-grant-hygiene.mjs, its two pins re-measured to e2af9f79). No gold, item or XP moves; no client RPC. ORDER: 1060 in its name, after every file on set/v0.2.144 (after 1032-approved-cuts.sql, whose detector carries the entry: its §0 refuses without it). EDGE-ORDER: either. EDGE: hr-accrue hunt-settle.js reads and commits a viewed ask with HUNT_READ_WATCHED_SQL / HUNT_APPLY_WATCHED_SQL (the same statements plus the note); on a database without this file they answer 42883 at parse and the ask goes with HUNT_READ_SQL / HUNT_APPLY_SQL as before, so either order. CLIENT: src/shell/away-recap.js judges a return from the later of the page's stamp and the section; a page before it reads only its own stamp. MEASURED (tests/per-player-cost.mjs fixtures, same tree): 0 statements and 0 round trips more; the watched four's 24 polls + 14 early asks (4 saving) wrote 42 hunt_watch rows (1 insert, 41 updates, 40 HOT), about 98 a hero-hour (3.9% of the fixture's row writes, inside the 20% band); every closed fixture 0. After the apply live-hash-drift wants hr_assert_grant_hygiene re-measured and hr_hunt_watch_gap, hr_hunt_watch_note and hr_hunt_watch_view seeded; restore-census and char-wipe carry hunt_watch.
